items.name: PlayBehavior / PlayMode-Experience / PlayFrame / PlayPractice separation
items.reason: survives animal, child, solitary/social, professional and Agent-era pressure; prevents behavior/experience/practice collapse

items.name: GameStructure / GameArtifact / GameInstance / Gameplay-Enactment / GameCategory separation
items.reason: survives same-artifact overlays, historical identity and category/framing evidence

items.name: Play != Game
items.reason: play without formal game structure and game execution without evidenced PlayMode both survive pressure

items.name: ExternalInstrumentality / ConsequenceCoupling coordinates
items.reason: robust descriptive/coupling axes but not category criteria or semantic primitives

items.name: CoupledLudicConfiguration
items.reason: useful causal factorization; not a definition, natural kind or unique predictive category theory

items.name: CounterfactualSlack
items.reason: too broad; science, art and engineering instantiate it; no necessary/sufficient role survives

items.name: ConstraintTransformation
items.reason: too broad; useful remainder absorbed by F4/F9 plus later AgencyScaffold/AgencySculpting analysis

items.name: ModelConflictProtocol
items.reason: epistemic method: theories conflict only when target, claim type, scope and predictions overlap

items.name: EvaluationLayering
items.reason: GameGoal, ParticipationPurpose, Process/PlayerValue and ExternalStake remain distinct under professional and matched manipulations

items.name: AgencySculpting
items.reason: strong domain-general action-problem/design mechanism; not Game-specific; belongs in Action/Control/Skill and later design-mechanism work

items.name: AgencyScaffold
items.reason: useful structural substrate broader than Game; retained as a derived view over F2/F4/F7/F8/F9

items.name: MechanismFamilyView
items.reason: prevents structure, experience, function and category from being forced into one universal mechanism

items.name: PolicyDifferentiation / AdaptivePolicyGain
items.reason: useful structural probe but not ludicness/PlayerValue metric; hand off to Action/Control/Skill and design falsification

items.name: DynamicEvaluationTopology
items.reason: NoFixedGlobalGoal != NoEvaluation survives; broader evaluation topology is general agency rather than Game-specific

items.name: ProgressSeparation
items.reason: WorldModelProgress != PerformanceProgress != PlayerValue; central dependency for Skill/Mastery/Challenge

items.name: StructuralExperientialDissociation
items.reason: GameExecution/competence evidence cannot be promoted into PlayExperience evidence; survives human and synthetic cases

items.name: Configuration causal-factorization
items.reason: configuration causality is real but mediator/outcome specific; no novel Game-specific essence

items.name: ConfigurationMediation
items.reason: configuration matters through changed meaning/evaluation/information/authority/feedback/stakes rather than generic gameness

items.name: OutcomeSpecificity
items.reason: PerformanceEffect != MotivationEffect != ExperienceEffect != CategoryEffect

items.name: ConstitutiveOverlay
items.reason: practice/rule overlays become structurally constitutive when they change admissibility, evaluation, transition interpretation, timing or valid evidence/history

items.name: CulturalPatterning
items.reason: strong social/cultural mechanism but belongs in later Social/Culture deep foundations

items.name: PracticeLineageContinuity
items.reason: needed for social/historical GameIdentity; exact ruleset identity rejected

items.name: CodificationGovernanceEffect
items.reason: important Media/Institution coupling; not necessary to keep in minimal Play/Game core

items.name: InstitutionalizationTransformation
items.reason: belongs in Social/Institution/Competition foundations

items.name: FrameAuthorityLocus
items.reason: frame may be maintained by self/group/community/institution/artifact/hybrid; social negotiation not universal

items.name: CategoryFeedback
items.reason: category can be historical outcome and later causal input; useful coupling, not mechanical essence

items.name: CategoryMechanismNonidentity
items.reason: mechanistic similarity != cultural category identity and category identity != mechanical equivalence

items.name: DissociationPressure
items.reason: Agent-era systems are primarily falsifiers of hidden role correlations, not evidence for a new Game atom

items.name: RuleProposal != RuleAuthority
items.reason: executable authority probe and social/institutional evidence support proposal/admission separation

items.name: RuleBelief != CurrentRuleTruth
items.reason: dynamic rules and stale-head probes require belief/currentness separation

items.name: NaturalLanguageIntent != AuthoritativeEffect
items.reason: open language expands representation/action proposal surface but effects remain authority/admission bounded

items.name: ProviderModelIdentity != AgentIdentity
items.reason: persistent subject identity/continuity is independent of model/provider implementation

items.name: Generation != Authorship != Adoption != CategoryLegitimacy
items.reason: prevents creation, authority and social-practice collapse

items.name: ConventionEmergence != InstitutionalLegitimacy
items.reason: descriptive convergence and legitimate/official authority are distinct

items.name: ProductionAgentNeed != RuntimeAgentNeed
items.reason: Agent production locus and shipped runtime locus are orthogonal

items.name: Process/LocalActivityValuation
items.reason: Human-owned participant mechanism; not Game-specific

items.name: Exploration/LearningProgress
items.reason: important subset mechanism; belongs in Discovery/Learning foundations

items.name: Perturbation/Recovery
items.reason: strong narrow play/skill mechanism; belongs in Challenge/Failure/Skill/Embodiment
